title_as_printed: Apparent molar heat capacity C_p,phi of CaCl2(aq)

footnotes_as_printed.a: The apparent molar heat capacity C_p,phi was calculated from equation (2).
footnotes_as_printed.b: The estimated accuracy delta of each value of C_p,phi/(J K-1 mol-1) was calculated assuming relative errors of 1 per cent in DeltaP/P and absolute errors estimated from the experimental sensitivity at each temperature. The absolute error estimates varied from +/-0.0001 to +/-0.0010.
footnotes_as_printed.c: Delta is the value of {C_p,phi(calculated) - C_p,phi(observed)}/(J K-1 mol-1). The calculated value is from a cubic-spline interpolation of the knots in table 2.
footnotes_as_printed.d: The value of the heat loss correction factor f was calculated using the heat capacity of 3.0053 mol kg-1 NaCl as a chemical standard. The measured values of DeltaP/P for 3.0053 mol kg-1 NaCl at the experimental pressure were -0.05154 at 306.82 K, -0.05062 at 306.55 K, -0.04954 at 306.36 K, -0.04813 at 306.21 K, -0.04828 at 307.17 K, -0.04744 at 324.39 K, -0.04963 at 349.86 K, -0.04894 at 350.06 K, -0.05918 at 403.95 K, -0.05934 at 400.99 K, -0.07366 at 451.18 K, -0.08671 at 500.92 K, -0.12527 at 551.88 K, -0.16103 at 577.89 K, -0.15076 at 577.86 K, and -0.21097 at 602.68 K.
footnotes_as_printed.e: These values were not included in the fit.

pressure_note: flow calorimeter back-pressure regulated; p printed in each block label (2.12 to 10.09 MPa for four blocks near 306 K, otherwise 17.20 to 17.82 MPa; authors state pressure varied between 17.2 and 17.8 MPa for the rest and treat it as 17.5 MPa)

value.what: apparent molar heat capacity of CaCl2 calculated by the authors from measured power ratio Ps/Pw and cp/cp* via their equation (2)

value2.what: measured electric power ratio of sample to water (primary measured quantity)

value3.what: specific heat capacity ratio of solution to water, derived from Ps/Pw with heat-loss factor f and densities

composition.other_species: none; CaCl2 in water, molality as printed (mol kg-1)

extra_unmapped: Delta (deviation from authors' cubic-spline fit, footnote c)
f (heat-loss correction factor of footnote d, printed in the block label rows; an instrument correction, not a composition)
notes: Two side-by-side blocks per T/p group stacked left block first then right block; the 350.06 K group spans two printed pages (left rows of both pages first, then right rows). Header footnote letters a (Cp,phi), b (delta), c (Delta) are not glued to numbers. Cells with footnote e in the Delta column have no Delta printed and carry note Delta:e (not included in the fit). Replicate rows kept (e.g. 350.06 K 0.0507 two identical rows). The e mark appears on the 11 rows of the 2-10 MPa blocks near 306 K (not used in the fit) and on 5 further rows (403.95 K x1, 451.18 K x1, 577.89 K x2, 602.68 K x1) which are the 5 points the authors eliminated; 232 data rows printed = 221 points of the text + 11 low-pressure rows.
